name: Cleathusk
description: Holds the hooked tip forward at shoulder height with the crescent guard turned outward to cover the leading forearm.

name: Clevishit
description: Drives the point straight forward from the hip with the rear foot pushing, leaving the hook behind the target's line.

name: Tripping Hookend
description: Passes the hooked tip over an attacker's wrist and pulls back so the wrist lodges against the inner bend.

name: Kept Cresthook
description: Catches an incoming cut on the crescent guard blade and rolls it off to the outside before stepping in.

name: Clevispace
description: Pushes off the lead foot and lands on the back heel, keeping the tip level while opening a body length.

name: Yankhit
description: Swings the hooked end through a wide rising arc over and over at half speed to build wrist control.

name: Disarmamble
description: Slides the lead foot a short stride ahead while the hooked tip trails low to guard the shin.

name: Sharp Hooktip
description: Turns the blade over and jabs the pommel spike into the ribs of a foe who has closed too far.

name: Grapnelcowl
description: Reaches the hooked tip outward past an incoming blade and drags it wide of the body.

name: Raised Hookspine
description: Brings both hands to the hilt and lifts the guard blade across the chest, holding the line against pressure.

name: Stopping Hookhilt
description: Drops the hooked tip behind a standing foe's lower leg and tugs, upsetting the stance without a cut.

name: Firm Hookneck
description: Chops down from above the head so the hooked point lands in the shoulder muscle and bites.

name: Blunt Disarm
description: Draws the inside curve of the blade upward along a limb in one stroke, cutting on the pull.

name: Hookguard Hit
description: Sweeps the hook across the body at knee height, taking the foe's front leg with the tip.

name: Hard Swordhook
description: Snaps the wrist so the hooked tip whips out and nicks the opponent's blade hand.

name: Solid Hookcurve
description: Stops a descending blade on the flat of the sword and slides it down toward the ground.

name: Quiet Hookcrook
description: Turns on the lead foot so the hooked end swings in behind the body as cover.

name: Square Hooklock
description: Pulls the curve of the blade backward across an arm that has been reached past, cutting as it retreats.

name: Hooding Hooktip
description: Raises the guard blade over the brow so overhead cuts strike its edge and not the head.

name: Planted Hookend
description: Drops the hooked tip toward the ground to check a low cut at the thigh.

name: Catching Yank
description: Presses the blade spine against an opponent's shoulder and pushes, breaking the rhythm of a charge.

name: Stepping Hookcurve
description: Sinks the hips and steps inside a cut, letting the crescent guard take any glancing edge.

name: Gnawing Pulldown
description: Answers a turned cut by thrusting the point under the foe's raised arm.

name: Tripping Hookhilt
description: Locks the hooked tip behind a blade and heaves back with the whole frame, holding the weapon trapped.

name: Turning Twistaway
description: Closes the hooked tip and guard blade on either side of an enemy blade and squeezes it still.

name: Narrow Cresthook
description: Drops body weight into a single downward chop that drives the hooked point deep into a limb.

name: Clevislid
description: Hooks a spear shaft behind the head and wrenches it sideways to throw off the thrust.

name: Folded Hookneck
description: Plants wide in a low square stance with both blades crossed, bearing a shove without moving back.

name: Snarlhit
description: Plants the rear heel and lunges forward, extending the point a full arm's length beyond the guard.

name: Fixing Pulldown
description: Slips the hooked end inside an enemy's bent elbow and draws, folding the arm against its owner.

name: Twistaway Hop
description: Twists the wrist to free a snagged tip and spins away along the line the pull opened.

name: Open Hooklock
description: Lets a breath of circulating qi lighten the blade through a rising hooked arc that cuts on its return.

name: Hooding Swordhook
description: Carries a touch of qi into the guard blade as it meets a cut, turning the edge cleanly aside.

name: Hitching Snarl
description: Steadies a trapped blade with a thin flow of qi through the hand, keeping the hook locked behind it.

name: Backward Yank
description: Glides forward on the balls of the feet with qi easing each stride while the tip trails low.

name: Grapnelbump
description: Raps the pommel spike against the opponent's hand with a quick turn of the forearm.

name: Upward Hookspine
description: Hooks the wrist, then pulls the inner edge back across the forearm in a single driving shear.

name: Grapnelhusk
description: Holds the crescent guard across the torso with qi steadying the arm against repeated cuts.

name: Cleviswedge
description: Rotates the blade in a small circle so a cut slides off like water down a slope.

name: Grapnelpause
description: Catches an opponent's sleeve with the hooked tip and tugs, spoiling the aim of the next strike.

name: Disarmdrop
description: Exhales through a straight thrust so the point travels true and the hooked end stays clear.

name: Clevisskitter
description: Slips one pace aside while the hook swings across, leaving the foe's cut to miss.

name: Catching Pulldown
description: Locks hooks with a drill partner and presses back with steady qi until the partner yields the line.

name: Folded Hookhilt
description: Meets a partner's blade edge to edge and slides along it, learning the angle where it parts.

name: Hookcrook Dash
description: Taps the hooked tip against the partner's wrist, marking the cut that would have landed.

name: Snarltrot
description: Mirrors a partner's stride forward and back so the gap between tips never changes.

name: Fouling Hookguard
description: Drags the partner's blade across the body and lets go, knocking the next thrust off its line.

name: Quick Yank
description: Passes the hook low across the knees in a controlled swing that stops just short of contact.

name: Cleatwedge
description: Lays the free forearm over the sword arm behind the guard blade, doubling the cover.

name: Snarlpace
description: Walks the length of a hall with the hooked end swaying low, qi easing each lifted foot.

name: Snarl Blow
description: Steps sideways off the attack line and cuts across the open flank with the curved edge.

name: Catching Hookguard
description: Catches a blade behind its guard and draws it back toward the body to open the opponent's chest.

name: Quiet Hookneck
description: Hops back off the heels in a single short bound, keeping the guard blade between the two fighters.

name: Towing Twistaway
description: Reaches the hooked tip under a shield rim and tips it up to expose the holder's ribs.

name: Folded Swordhook
description: Holds the point level at the throat of an approaching foe so that the advance must stop.

name: Locking Hookcurve
description: Strokes the barbed tip across the back of the enemy hand to snag the glove and pull the grip loose.

name: Cleatblow
description: Swings the crescent guard forward like a short blade and strikes the opponent's forearm.

name: Cleatpause
description: Rolls the wrist in a tight circle to bat aside two quick cuts at the hand.

name: Hookcrook Pause
description: Beats the hooked tip against an enemy's raised blade, forcing it out of line before the follow-up.

name: Quiet Hooktip
description: Pulls the rear foot up as the hooked blade draws back, closing distance behind the pull.

name: Stopping Disarm
description: Lifts a hooked wrist upward with the beard of the blade, exposing the arm beneath it.

name: Sudden Snarl
description: Slashes with the straight edge in a flat arc across the opponent's middle without turning the hook.

name: Resting Cresthook
description: Cups an incoming thrust in the bend of the blade and sweeps it past the hip.

name: Upward Swordhook
description: Flips the grip so the hooked edge faces forward and chops downward over a lowered guard.

name: Grapnelamble
description: Steps in with the hook extended first, so the tip lands before the foot settles.

name: Fixing Cresthook
description: Pins a trapped sword against the opponent's own thigh and leans to keep it pressed.
